notes:
Clarify 0.12.0 rebuilds desktop Settings with page-specific Save and Discard actions. Navigation stays available during microphone tests, refreshes and saves.

Preferences, shortcuts and flags on saved dictionary or snippet rows save automatically. Text and numeric drafts remain local until you save the current page. Provider key and connection URL edits on Models and services require Validate and save key. Validate or discard those edits before saving other drafts. Closing Settings can handle drafts from all pages.

The update preserves text typed while an earlier save is pending, synchronized library rows and account ownership. Provider and local-model operations retain their original targets. Settings waits for accepted automatic writes before closing.

Audio discovery runs outside the Qt thread. Shutdown rejects late inventory and local-model notifications without making workers retain the Qt controller.

Existing profiles, provider keys and saved libraries retain their data. The portable Windows executable remains unsigned; SmartScreen can show a warning. The release evidence will state the native checks performed and the existing acceptance limits.

Scoped Windows evidence for the exact base combines native UI Automation, original backend and persistence records, and coordinator inspection of owned-window captures. No human manual interaction is claimed. Real audio/providers, physical DPI, global hotkeys, tray, transparency, passive pill focus and prolonged use retain their existing unverified limits. Earlier failed CDP diagnostics remain recorded. The earlier native Ubuntu segfault cause remains unproven. iOS publication is separate.
